tool_schemas.name: get_workspace_hierarchy
tool_schemas.description: Returns the workspace container tree for the given workspaceId, including spaces and (optionally) folders and lists up to maxDepth, and returns archived containers only when includeArchived=true. This endpoint is not paged; it returns the full hierarchy for the requested depth in a single response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when workspaceId format is invalid or maxDepth is outside 1–3, NOT_FOUND when the workspace does not exist or is not accessible to the caller, and FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to view the workspace hierarchy.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id to fetch hierarchy for.

includeArchived.description: Whether to include archived containers in the hierarchy.

tool_schemas.name: create_task
tool_schemas.description: Creates a single task in the target list (resolved by listId, or by listName if provided) and returns the created task record; if parent is provided, the task is created as a subtask under that parent task. Validates required inputs (name and exactly one list selector), validates that status is a valid status for the destination list, that timeEstimateMs is non-negative, and that customFields entries are objects with {id,value}. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid fields or invalid assignees/custom field payloads, NOT_FOUND when the target list (or parent task) cannot be resolved, CONFLICT when listName resolves to multiple lists or when the requested status is not available in the destination list, and FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot create tasks in the destination list.

listId.description: Destination list container id to create the task in (preferred).

listName.description: Destination list name to create the task in (used if listId not provided; may be ambiguous).

parent.description: Parent task id to create this task as a subtask under.

status.description: Task status name (must be valid for the target list).

assignees.description: Assignees as an array of ClickUp user IDs, emails, or usernames.

value.description: Custom field value (type depends on field).

customFields.description: Custom fields as array of {id, value}.

tool_schemas.name: get_task
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns a task by taskId (including ClickUp regular/custom IDs) or by resolving taskName (optionally scoped by listName), and includes full subtask details when subtasks=true. This endpoint is not paged; it returns a single task object (with embedded subtasks when requested). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when neither taskId nor taskName is provided, NOT_FOUND when no matching task exists (or listName scope does not exist), CONFLICT when taskName resolution is ambiguous (multiple matches, especially without listName), and FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot view the resolved task.

taskId.description: Task id to fetch (accepts internal id and ClickUp regular/custom task IDs).

taskName.description: Task name to search for (may be ambiguous).

listName.description: List name to scope taskName search for faster/safer lookup.

subtasks.description: Whether to include all subtask details.

tool_schemas.name: update_task
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing task (resolved by taskId, or by taskName optionally scoped by listName) and returns the updated task record; at least one updatable field must be provided. Validates field formats (date-time strings, non-negative timeEstimateMs, customFields as {id,value} objects) and validates that any provided status is valid for the task’s list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when no update fields are provided or payload fields are invalid, NOT_FOUND when the task cannot be resolved, CONFLICT when taskName resolution is ambiguous or when attempting to set a status that is not available for the task’s list, and FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to edit the task.

taskName.description: Task name to search for and update (may be ambiguous).

listName.description: List name to scope taskName search (recommended when using taskName).

priority.description: New task priority as an integer.

assignees.description: Assignees as an array of ClickUp user IDs, emails, or usernames.

value.description: Custom field value (type depends on field).

customFields.description: Custom fields as array of {id, value}.

tool_schemas.name: move_task
tool_schemas.description: Moves a task (resolved by taskId, or by taskName scoped with sourceListName) to a destination list (resolved by listId or listName) and returns the moved task record; note that the task’s status may be adjusted if the destination list uses a different status set. Validates that the source task and destination list can be uniquely resolved and that the move is permitted. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing required selectors, NOT_FOUND when the task, source list, or destination list cannot be found, CONFLICT when taskName/listName resolution is ambiguous, and FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot move the task or create tasks in the destination list.

taskName.description: Task name to search for and move (may be ambiguous).

sourceListName.description: Source list name to disambiguate when moving by taskName.

listName.description: Destination list name (used if listId not provided; may be ambiguous).

tool_schemas.name: duplicate_task
tool_schemas.description: Creates a copy of an existing task (resolved by taskId, or by taskName scoped with sourceListName) in the same list by default, or in a destination list when listId/listName is provided, and returns the newly created duplicated task record. Validates that the source task and (if provided) destination list can be uniquely resolved. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid identifiers, NOT_FOUND when the source task or destination list cannot be found, CONFLICT when name-based resolution is ambiguous, and FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to read the source task or create tasks in the destination list.

taskName.description: Task name to search for and duplicate (may be ambiguous).

sourceListName.description: Source list name to disambiguate when duplicating by taskName.

listId.description: Destination list container id for the duplicated task (defaults to original list).

listName.description: Destination list name for the duplicated task (defaults to original list).

tool_schemas.name: delete_task
tool_schemas.description: Permanently deletes a task (resolved by taskId, or by taskName optionally scoped by listName) and returns a deletion confirmation for the resolved task. Validates that the task can be uniquely resolved before deleting, and deletion cannot be undone. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when neither taskId nor taskName is provided, NOT_FOUND when the task cannot be found, CONFLICT when taskName resolution is ambiguous (especially without listName), and FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to delete the task.

taskName.description: Task name to search for and delete (may be ambiguous).

listName.description: List name to scope taskName search (recommended).

tool_schemas.name: get_task_comments
tool_schemas.description: Gets task comments. Use taskId (preferred) or taskName + optional listName. Use start/startId params for pagination. Task names may not be unique across lists.

taskId.description: Task id to fetch comments for (preferred).

taskName.description: Task name to search for to fetch comments (may be ambiguous).

listName.description: List name to scope taskName search (recommended).

start.description: Offset index for pagination (used to fetch the next page of comments).

startId.description: Activity/comment id cursor to start after for pagination.

tool_schemas.name: create_task_comment
tool_schemas.description: Creates task comment. Use taskId (preferred) or taskName + listName. Required: commentText. Optional: notifyAll to notify assignees, assignee to assign comment.

taskId.description: Internal task id (preferred) to comment on.

taskName.description: Task name to resolve when taskId is not provided (may be ambiguous).

listName.description: List name used to disambiguate taskName when taskId is not provided.

notifyAll.description: Whether to notify all assignees/watchers on the task.

assignee.description: User to assign the comment to (e.g., ClickUp user id, email, or username depending on workspace resolution).

tool_schemas.name: attach_task_file
tool_schemas.description: Attaches file to task. Use taskId (preferred) or taskName + optional listName. File sources: 1) base64 + filename (≤10MB), 2) URL (http/https), 3) local path (absolute), 4) chunked for large files. WARNING: taskName without listName may match multiple tasks.

taskId.description: Internal task id (preferred) to attach the file to.

taskName.description: Task name to resolve when taskId is not provided (may be ambiguous without listName).

listName.description: Optional list name to disambiguate taskName.

filename.description: Filename for the attachment (required for base64; recommended otherwise when available).

url.description: Publicly accessible http/https URL when sourceType=url.

localPath.description: Absolute local filesystem path when sourceType=local_path.

uploadId.description: Identifier for a previously initiated chunked upload.

partNumber.description: Chunk part number (1-based) when uploading a part.

totalParts.description: Total number of parts for the chunked upload.

base64Part.description: Base64-encoded data for this chunk part.

complete.description: Whether this request completes/finalizes the chunked upload.

tool_schemas.name: create_bulk_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Creates multiple tasks in a single destination List (resolved by listId, or by listName when listId is omitted) and returns the created task records; tasks are submitted in client-controlled batches using options.batchSize and processed with options.concurrency (this endpoint does not paginate results). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tasks is empty, any task is missing name, or fields violate schema (e.g., negative timeEstimateMs), NOT_FOUND if the destination List cannot be resolved, AMBIGUOUS if listName resolves to more than one List, FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to create tasks in the List, and RATE_LIMITED if workspace or user write quotas are exceeded.

listName.description: Destination list name to resolve when listId is not provided.

assignees.description: Assignees as an array of user identifiers (user IDs, emails, or usernames).

value.description: Custom field value (type depends on the custom field).

customFields.description: Custom fields to set as an array of {id, value}.

tasks.description: Array of tasks to create (each task requires name).

batchSize.description: Maximum number of tasks to send per batch.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of batches to process concurrently.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def create_bulk_tasks(tasks, listId=None, listName=None, options=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, secrets

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0264000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0264000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "create_bulk_tasks"

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

    def _append_log(status, error_code=None, meta=None):
        logs = _load("request_log.json")
        if not isinstance(logs, list): logs = []
        row = {
            "id": f"req_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{secrets.token_hex(4)}",
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "timestamp": _now(),
            "status": status,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "credential_id": None,
            "meta": meta or {},
        }
        if error_code: row["error_code"] = error_code
        logs.append(row)
        _save("request_log.json", logs)

    if not isinstance(tasks, list) or len(tasks) < 1:
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "tasks must be a non-empty array.")
        _append_log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    if listId is None and listName is None:
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Either listId or listName must be provided.")
        _append_log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    if listId is not None and (not isinstance(listId, str) or not listId.strip()):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "listId must be a non-empty string when provided.")
        _append_log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    if listName is not None and (not isinstance(listName, str) or not listName.strip()):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "listName must be a non-empty string when provided.")
        _append_log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    if options is not None and not isinstance(options, dict):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "options must be an object when provided.")
        _append_log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    if isinstance(options, dict):
        if "batchSize" in options and (not isinstance(options["batchSize"], int) or options["batchSize"] < 1):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "options.batchSize must be an integer >= 1")
            _append_log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
            return e
        if "concurrency" in options and (not isinstance(options["concurrency"], int) or options["concurrency"] < 1):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "options.concurrency must be an integer >= 1")
            _append_log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
            return e

    results = []
    created = []
    for idx, item in enumerate(tasks):
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            results.append({"index": idx, "ok": False, "error": _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "task item must be an object")["error"]})
            continue
        # Delegate to create_task rules (single-item semantics)
        resp = create_task(
            name=item.get("name"),
            listId=listId,
            listName=listName,
            parent=None,
            description=item.get("description"),
            status=item.get("status"),
            priority=item.get("priority"),
            startDate=item.get("startDate"),
            dueDate=item.get("dueDate"),
            timeEstimateMs=item.get("timeEstimateMs"),
            assignees=item.get("assignees"),
            customFields=item.get("customFields"),
        )
        if isinstance(resp, dict) and "error" in resp:
            results.append({"index": idx, "ok": False, "error": resp["error"]})
        else:
            task_row = resp.get("task") if isinstance(resp, dict) else None
            results.append({"index": idx, "ok": True, "task": task_row})
            if task_row:
                created.append(task_row)

    _append_log("ok", meta={"created_count": len(created), "requested_count": len(tasks)})
    return {"results": results, "tasks": created}

tool_schemas.name: update_bulk_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Updates multiple tasks efficiently. For each task: use taskId (preferred) or taskName + listName. At least one update field per task. Supports assignees as array of user IDs, emails, or usernames. Configure batch size/concurrency via options. WARNING: taskName without listName will fail.

taskName.description: Task name to resolve when taskId is not provided.

listName.description: List name used to resolve taskName (required when using taskName).

assignees.description: Assignees as an array of user identifiers (user IDs, emails, or usernames).

value.description: Custom field value (type depends on the custom field).

customFields.description: Custom fields to update as an array of {id, value}.

items.description: One task update instruction (must include taskId or taskName+listName, and at least one update field).

batchSize.description: Maximum number of task updates to send per batch.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of batches to process concurrently.

tool_schemas.name: move_bulk_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Moves multiple existing tasks into a target List (resolved by targetListId, or by targetListName when omitted) and returns the updated task records; requests are executed in batches using options.batchSize and options.concurrency (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any move item is missing taskId or taskName+listName, NOT_FOUND if a task, source List (when resolving by name), or target List cannot be found, AMBIGUOUS if taskName+listName or targetListName resolves to multiple matches, FORBIDDEN if you cannot access the task or cannot add it to the target List, and CONFLICT if a task cannot be moved due to its current state or because the target List does not accept the task’s current status (statuses may be reset when moved).

targetListId.description: Target list container id to move tasks into (preferred).

targetListName.description: Target list name to resolve when targetListId is not provided.

taskName.description: Task name to resolve when taskId is not provided.

listName.description: Source list name used to resolve taskName (required when using taskName).

items.description: One task move instruction (must include taskId or taskName+listName).

batchSize.description: Maximum number of task moves to send per batch.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of batches to process concurrently.

tool_schemas.name: delete_bulk_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Permanently deletes multiple tasks and returns a per-item deletion result; operations are executed in batches controlled by options.batchSize and options.concurrency (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any delete item is missing taskId or taskName+listName, NOT_FOUND if the task (or source List when resolving by name) cannot be found, AMBIGUOUS if taskName+listName resolves to multiple tasks, FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to delete the task, and CONFLICT if the task cannot be deleted due to its current state or retention constraints.

taskId.description: Internal task id to permanently delete (preferred/safest).

taskName.description: Task name to resolve when taskId is not provided.

listName.description: Source list name used to resolve taskName (required when using taskName).

items.description: One task delete instruction (must include taskId or taskName+listName).

tasks.description: Array of tasks to permanently delete.

batchSize.description: Maximum number of task deletions to send per batch.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of batches to process concurrently.

tool_schemas.name: get_workspace_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Purpose: Retrieve tasks from across the entire workspace with powerful filtering options, including tag-based filtering. Valid Usage: 1. Apply any combination of filters (tags, lists, folders, spaces, statuses, etc.) 2. Use pagination to manage large result sets 3. Include subtasks by setting subtasks=true Requirements: - At least one filter parameter is REQUIRED (tags, list_ids, folder_ids, space_ids, statuses, assignees, or date filters) - Pagination parameters (page, order_by, reverse) alone are not considered filters Notes: - Provides workspace-wide task access (unlike get_tasks which only searches in one list) - Returns complete task details including descriptions, assignees, custom fields, and all metadata - Tag filtering is especially useful for cross-list organization (e.g., "project-x", "blocker", "needs-review") - Combine multiple filters to narrow down your search scope - Use pagination for large result sets - Set subtasks=true to include subtask details in the response IMPORTANT: subtasks=true enables subtasks to appear in results, but subtasks must still match your other filter criteria (tags, lists, etc.) to be returned. To see all subtasks of a specific task regardless of filters, use the get_task tool with subtasks=true instead. - Use the detail_level parameter to control the amount of data returned: - "summary": Returns lightweight task data (name, status, list, tags) - "detailed": Returns complete task data with all fields (DEFAULT if not specified) - Responses exceeding 50,000 tokens automatically switch to summary format to avoid hitting LLM token limits - **Enhanced List Filtering**: When list_ids are provided, the tool leverages ClickUp's Views API to include tasks that are *associated with* the specified lists, including tasks that have been added to multiple lists. This provides comprehensive coverage of all tasks related to your specified lists, not just tasks that were originally created in those lists.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id to query tasks from.

tags.description: Filter to tasks having one or more of these tag names.

list_ids.description: Filter to tasks in these list container ids.

folder_ids.description: Filter to tasks under these folder container ids.

space_ids.description: Filter to tasks under these space container ids.

statuses.description: Filter to tasks whose status name is in this set.

assignee_clickup_user_ids.description: Filter to tasks assigned to any of these ClickUp user ids.

subtasks.description: Whether to include subtasks in the results.

archived.description: Whether to include archived tasks (if supported by the workspace).

due_after.description: Filter to tasks with due date after this timestamp.

due_before.description: Filter to tasks with due date before this timestamp.

updated_after.description: Filter to tasks updated after this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_task_time_entries
tool_schemas.description: Lists time entries for a task (resolved by taskId, or by taskName with optional listName) and returns matching entries including user info, description, tags, start/end timestamps, duration, and billable/running flags; results are paged with limit (max 200) and an opaque cursor returned for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid time window filters or invalid limit, NOT_FOUND if the task cannot be resolved, AMBIGUOUS if taskName (optionally scoped by listName) matches more than one task, FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the task or its time tracking data, and RATE_LIMITED if read quotas are exceeded.

taskId.description: Internal task id (preferred) to fetch time entries for.

taskName.description: Task name to resolve when taskId is not provided.

listName.description: Optional list name to disambiguate taskName.

start_time_after.description: Filter to time entries starting after this timestamp.

start_time_before.description: Filter to time entries starting before this timestamp.

end_time_after.description: Filter to time entries ending after this timestamp.

end_time_before.description: Filter to time entries ending before this timestamp.

running.description: If provided, filter to running=true/false time entries.

billable.description: If provided, filter to billable=true/false time entries.

user_clickup_ids.description: Filter to time entries created by any of these ClickUp user ids.

tags.description: Filter to time entries containing any of these tag names.

limit.description: Maximum number of time entries to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: start_time_tracking
tool_schemas.description: Starts a running time entry for the specified task within the given workspaceId and returns the running time entry; the task is resolved by taskId or by taskName (optionally disambiguated by listName), and optional description, billable, and tags are applied. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspaceId is missing/invalid or neither taskId nor taskName is provided, NOT_FOUND if the workspace or task cannot be resolved, AMBIGUOUS if taskName resolution is not unique, FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to track time in the workspace or on the task, CONFLICT if you already have a running timer in that workspace (only one running timer is allowed per user/workspace), and RATE_LIMITED if time-tracking write quotas are exceeded.

workspaceId.description: Workspace (team) id in which to start the timer.

taskId.description: Task id to start time tracking on (preferred).

taskName.description: Task name to resolve when taskId is not provided (may be ambiguous).

listName.description: Optional list name to disambiguate taskName.

description.description: Optional description for the running time entry.

billable.description: Whether the time entry is billable.

tags.description: Optional tags to apply to the time entry.

tool_schemas.name: stop_time_tracking
tool_schemas.description: Stops the currently running time entry in the specified workspaceId and returns the completed time entry with end time and duration, optionally updating description and tags. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspaceId is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if there is no running timer to stop in that workspace, FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to manage time tracking in the workspace, CONFLICT if the running entry cannot be stopped due to its current state, and RATE_LIMITED if time-tracking write quotas are exceeded.

workspaceId.description: Workspace (team) id in which to stop the currently running timer.

description.description: Optional description to set/override on the completed time entry.

tags.description: Optional tags to set/override on the completed time entry.

tool_schemas.name: add_time_entry
tool_schemas.description: Adds a manual time entry to a task. Use taskId (preferred) or taskName + optional listName. Required: start time, duration. Optional: description, billable, tags.

workspaceId.description: Workspace (team) id in which to create the manual time entry.

taskId.description: Task id to add the time entry to (preferred).

taskName.description: Task name to resolve when taskId is not provided (may be ambiguous).

listName.description: Optional list name to disambiguate taskName.

startTime.description: Start time of the manual time entry (ISO 8601).

durationMs.description: Duration of the time entry in milliseconds.

description.description: Optional description for the time entry.

billable.description: Whether the time entry is billable.

tags.description: Optional tags to apply to the time entry.

tool_schemas.name: delete_time_entry
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a time entry. Required: time entry ID.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_time_entry
tool_schemas.description: Gets the currently running time entry, if any. No parameters needed.

workspaceId.description: Workspace (team) id to check for a running timer.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_current_time_entry(workspaceId, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0264000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0264000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    # validate
    if not isinstance(workspaceId, str) or not re.match(r"^cu_wsp_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", workspaceId):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "workspaceId must be a string matching ^cu_wsp_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$")

    workspaces = _load("workspaces.json")
    members = _load("members.json")
    activity = _load("task_activity.json")

    # resolve workspace (by clickup_team_id)
    wsp = next((w for w in workspaces if w.get("clickup_team_id") == workspaceId and w.get("status") != "deleted"), None)
    if not wsp:
        # log attempt (best-effort to store)
        logs = _load("request_log.json")
        logs.append({
            "id": f"cu_req_{datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}_{len(logs)+1}",
            "tool": "get_current_time_entry",
            "workspace_clickup_team_id": workspaceId,
            "workspace_id": None,
            "status": "NOT_FOUND",
            "timestamp": now,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
        })
        _save("request_log.json", logs)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Workspace not found")

    if wsp.get("status") != "active":
        logs = _load("request_log.json")
        logs.append({
            "id": f"cu_req_{datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}_{len(logs)+1}",
            "tool": "get_current_time_entry",
            "workspace_clickup_team_id": workspaceId,
            "workspace_id": wsp.get("id"),
            "status": "UNAUTHORIZED",
            "timestamp": now,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
        })
        _save("request_log.json", logs)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Workspace is not active")

    # Ambient auth: pick a calling member "when available".
    # If multiple active members exist, choose a deterministic one (owner/admin first) to represent the caller.
    role_rank = {"owner": 0, "admin": 1, "member": 2, "guest": 3}
    cand_members = [m for m in members if m.get("workspace_id") == wsp.get("id") and m.get("status") == "active"]
    if not cand_members:
        logs = _load("request_log.json")
        logs.append({
            "id": f"cu_req_{datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}_{len(logs)+1}",
            "tool": "get_current_time_entry",
            "workspace_clickup_team_id": workspaceId,
            "workspace_id": wsp.get("id"),
            "status": "UNAUTHORIZED",
            "timestamp": now,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
        })
        _save("request_log.json", logs)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No active member context available for workspace")

    cand_members.sort(key=lambda m: (role_rank.get(m.get("role") or "member", 9), m.get("created_at") or "", m.get("id") or ""))
    caller = cand_members[0]

    # find running time entry for calling member in workspace
    running = [
        r for r in activity
        if r.get("workspace_id") == wsp.get("id")
        and r.get("kind") == "time_entry"
        and r.get("status") == "active"
        and r.get("author_member_id") == caller.get("id")
        and r.get("running") is True
    ]
    running.sort(key=lambda r: (r.get("created_at") or "", r.get("id") or ""))

    result = running[0] if running else None

    # request log (observable dynamics)
    logs = _load("request_log.json")
    logs.append({
        "id": f"cu_req_{datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}_{len(logs)+1}",
        "tool": "get_current_time_entry",
        "workspace_clickup_team_id": workspaceId,
        "workspace_id": wsp.get("id"),
        "member_id": caller.get("id"),
        "status": "OK",
        "timestamp": now,
        "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
    })
    _save("request_log.json", logs)

    return {
        "workspaceId": workspaceId,
        "member": {
            "id": caller.get("id"),
            "clickupUserId": caller.get("clickup_user_id"),
            "fullName": caller.get("full_name"),
            "role": caller.get("role"),
        },
        "timeEntry": result
    }

tool_schemas.implementation:
def create_list_in_folder(workspaceId, folderId=None, folderName=None, spaceId=None, spaceName=None, name=None, content=None, status=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, secrets

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0264000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0264000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "create_list_in_folder"

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

    def _log(status_s, error_code=None, meta=None):
        logs = _load("request_log.json")
        if not isinstance(logs, list):
            logs = []
        logs.append({
            "id": f"req_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{secrets.token_hex(4)}",
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "timestamp": _now(),
            "status": status_s,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "credential_id": None,
            **({"error_code": error_code} if error_code else {}),
            "meta": meta or {},
        })
        _save("request_log.json", logs)

    def _gen_id(prefix):
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
        return f"{prefix}{''.join(secrets.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(22))}"

    if not isinstance(workspaceId, str) or not workspaceId.strip():
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "workspaceId must be a non-empty string")
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    wsid = workspaceId.strip()

    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip():
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "name is required and must be a non-empty string", rule="name <> ''")
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    list_name = name.strip()

    if content is not None and not isinstance(content, str):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "content must be a string when provided")
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e

    if status is not None:
        if not isinstance(status, str) or status not in ("active", "deleted"):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "status must be 'active' or 'deleted' when provided")
            _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
            return e

    if folderId is None and folderName is None:
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Provide folderId or folderName.")
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    if folderId is not None and (not isinstance(folderId, str) or not folderId.strip()):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "folderId must be a non-empty string when provided.")
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    if folderName is not None and (not isinstance(folderName, str) or not folderName.strip()):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "folderName must be a non-empty string when provided.")
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    if folderName is not None and spaceId is None and spaceName is None:
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "When using folderName, you must also provide spaceId or spaceName for disambiguation.")
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    if spaceId is not None and (not isinstance(spaceId, str) or not spaceId.strip()):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "spaceId must be a non-empty string when provided.")
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    if spaceName is not None and (not isinstance(spaceName, str) or not spaceName.strip()):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "spaceName must be a non-empty string when provided.")
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e

    workspaces = _load("workspaces.json")
    containers = _load("containers.json")
    if not isinstance(workspaces, list):
        workspaces = []
    if not isinstance(containers, list):
        containers = []

    ws = None
    for w in workspaces:
        if isinstance(w, dict) and w.get("id") == wsid:
            ws = w
            break
    if not ws or ws.get("status") != "active":
        e = _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Workspace is not available.", workspaceId=wsid, workspaceStatus=(ws.get("status") if ws else None))
        _log("error", "UNAUTHORIZED")
        return e

    # Resolve folder
    folder = None
    if folderId is not None:
        fid = folderId.strip()
        for c in containers:
            if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("id") == fid and c.get("type") == "folder" and c.get("status") == "active" and c.get("workspace_id") == wsid:
                folder = c
                break
        if not folder:
            e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "folder not found", folderId=fid, workspaceId=wsid)
            _log("error", "NOT_FOUND")
            return e
    else:
        # Resolve space first then folder by name within that space
        space = None
        if spaceId is not None:
            sid = spaceId.strip()
            for c in containers:
                if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("id") == sid and c.get("type") == "space" and c.get("status") == "active" and c.get("workspace_id") == wsid:
                    space = c
                    break
            if not space:
                e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "space not found", spaceId=sid, workspaceId=wsid)
                _log("error", "NOT_FOUND")
                return e
        else:
            sn = spaceName.strip()
            candidates = [c for c in containers if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("type") == "space" and c.get("status") == "active" and c.get("workspace_id") == wsid and c.get("name") == sn]
            if len(candidates) == 0:
                e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "space not found", spaceName=sn, workspaceId=wsid)
                _log("error", "NOT_FOUND")
                return e
            if len(candidates) > 1:
                e = _err("CONFLICT", "spaceName is ambiguous within workspace; provide spaceId.", spaceName=sn, matches=len(candidates))
                _log("error", "CONFLICT")
                return e
            space = candidates[0]

        fn = folderName.strip()
        folder_candidates = [c for c in containers if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("type") == "folder" and c.get("status") == "active" and c.get("workspace_id") == wsid and c.get("parent_id") == space.get("id") and c.get("name") == fn]
        if len(folder_candidates) == 0:
            e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "folder not found", folderName=fn, spaceId=space.get("id"), workspaceId=wsid)
            _log("error", "NOT_FOUND")
            return e
        if len(folder_candidates) > 1:
            e = _err("CONFLICT", "folderName is ambiguous within space; provide folderId.", folderName=fn, spaceId=space.get("id"), matches=len(folder_candidates))
            _log("error", "CONFLICT")
            return e
        folder = folder_candidates[0]

    now = _now()
    new_row = {
        "id": _gen_id("cu_cnt_"),
        "workspace_id": wsid,
        "type": "list",
        "parent_id": folder.get("id"),
        "clickup_id": _gen_id("culst_"),
        "name": list_name,
        "content": (content if content is not None else None),
        "archived": False,
        "due_date": None,
        "priority": None,
        "assignee_member_id": None,
        "override_statuses": None,
        "status": (status if status is not None else "active"),
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }

    containers.append(new_row)
    _save("containers.json", containers)

    _log("ok", meta={"list_id": new_row["id"], "folder_id": folder.get("id"), "workspace_id": wsid})
    return {"list": new_row}

tool_schemas.implementation:
def create_folder(spaceId=None, spaceName=None, name=None, content=None, override_statuses=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, secrets

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0264000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0264000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "create_folder"

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

    def _log(status_s, error_code=None, meta=None):
        logs = _load("request_log.json")
        if not isinstance(logs, list):
            logs = []
        logs.append({
            "id": f"req_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{secrets.token_hex(4)}",
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "timestamp": _now(),
            "status": status_s,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "credential_id": None,
            **({"error_code": error_code} if error_code else {}),
            "meta": meta or {},
        })
        _save("request_log.json", logs)

    def _gen_id(prefix):
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
        return f"{prefix}{''.join(secrets.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(22))}"

    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip():
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "name is required and must be a non-empty string.", rule="name <> ''")
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    folder_name = name.strip()

    if content is not None and not isinstance(content, str):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "content must be a string when provided.")
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    if override_statuses is not None and not isinstance(override_statuses, list):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "override_statuses must be an array when provided.")
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e

    if spaceId is None and spaceName is None:
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "You must provide spaceId or spaceName.")
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    if spaceId is not None and (not isinstance(spaceId, str) or not spaceId.strip()):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "spaceId must be a non-empty string when provided.")
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    if spaceName is not None and (not isinstance(spaceName, str) or not spaceName.strip()):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "spaceName must be a non-empty string when provided.")
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e

    workspaces = _load("workspaces.json")
    containers = _load("containers.json")
    if not isinstance(workspaces, list):
        workspaces = []
    if not isinstance(containers, list):
        containers = []

    cont_by_id = {c.get("id"): c for c in containers if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("id")}

    # Resolve space
    space = None
    if spaceId is not None:
        sid = spaceId.strip()
        s = cont_by_id.get(sid)
        if s and s.get("type") == "space" and s.get("status") == "active":
            space = s
        else:
            e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "space not found", spaceId=sid)
            _log("error", "NOT_FOUND")
            return e
    else:
        sn = spaceName.strip()
        candidates = [c for c in containers if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("type") == "space" and c.get("status") == "active" and c.get("name") == sn]
        if len(candidates) == 0:
            e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "space not found", spaceName=sn)
            _log("error", "NOT_FOUND")
            return e
        if len(candidates) > 1:
            e = _err("CONFLICT", "spaceName is ambiguous; provide spaceId.", spaceName=sn, matches=len(candidates))
            _log("error", "CONFLICT")
            return e
        space = candidates[0]

    wsid = space.get("workspace_id")
    ws = None
    for w in workspaces:
        if isinstance(w, dict) and w.get("id") == wsid:
            ws = w
            break
    if not ws or ws.get("status") != "active":
        e = _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Workspace is not available.", workspaceId=wsid, workspaceStatus=(ws.get("status") if ws else None))
        _log("error", "UNAUTHORIZED")
        return e

    now = _now()
    new_row = {
        "id": _gen_id("cu_cnt_"),
        "workspace_id": wsid,
        "type": "folder",
        "parent_id": space.get("id"),
        "clickup_id": _gen_id("cufld_"),
        "name": folder_name,
        "content": (content if content is not None else None),
        "archived": False,
        "due_date": None,
        "priority": None,
        "assignee_member_id": None,
        "override_statuses": (override_statuses if override_statuses is not None else None),
        "status": "active",
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }

    containers.append(new_row)
    _save("containers.json", containers)

    _log("ok", meta={"folder_id": new_row["id"], "space_id": space.get("id"), "workspace_id": wsid})
    return {"folder": new_row}
